messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — AcmeHealth is asking for a 6-month Dedicated commit. They want 4x A100 reserved with autoscale to 8x for peaks. Pricing question: can we offer a 10% rebate for the commit plus reduced burst rate?
Ajay Patel: Do we have the current rate card for 4x and burst per-GPU? I can run numbers if we know expected TPS and avg seq length.
Heather Lopez: Finance: our standard committed discount tiers are 10% for 6mo at that size, but burst is billed at 2x baseline unless we pre-approve burst credits. Need deal-desk approval for any lower burst multiplier.
Tom Nguyen: Technical: autoscale to 8x is doable. Need to confirm GPU mix — is the customer ok with mixed A100/T4 for burst? That materially changes latency. Also KV/prefix cache will reduce token usage on chat workloads.
Maria Chen: Customer insists on A100-only for both reserved and burst. Also asking for a hard cap on monthly burst spend ($25k) and auto-throttle after cap.
Ajay Patel: I can model costs with those params. Quick ask: what's their expected 9-5 qps and avg seq length? If we assume 100 qps and avg seq 256, I can estimate tokens/hour and monthly spend.
Heather Lopez: Quick rate-card snippet for reference:
```
reserved_4xA100_monthly = $38,000
burst_multiplier_default = 2.0
burst_rate_per_gpu_hour_A100 = $200
```
(placeholder numbers, will validate)
Karen Park: Legal: if we add a capped-spend auto-throttle we need a short amendment — limit on liability and clear termination triggers. Also confirm whether VPC peering + audit logs is sufficient for their compliance team.
Maria Chen: They prefer Dedicated (no Private). VPC peering + SOC2 audit logs should be fine but they want SLA language specifically calling out burst availability during business hours.
Tom Nguyen: SLA guaranteeing burst availability is tricky. We can commit to burst best-effort up to pool capacity and offer a higher reserved baseline or standby reserved nodes for guaranteed headroom. Standby nodes would change pricing.
Heather Lopez: Proposal: keep 10% commit discount, reduce burst multiplier from 2.0 -> 1.5 for this customer for 6 months if they accept a $25k monthly burst cap and pre-authorize auto-throttle. That requires deal-desk sign-off.
deal-desk-bot: New deal created: ACME-DED-6M. Approvals required: finance, infra-ops, legal. Review ETA: 24 hours.
Ajay Patel: I'll produce a cost model EOD with avg seq 256 and 100 qps 9-5. Will include scenarios: conservative (1.5 multiplier), standard (2.0), and guaranteed (standby nodes + higher reserved).
Maria Chen: Thanks — if deal-desk OKs 1.5 multiplier + 10% commit and we add the capped-spend clause, customer is likely to sign this week.
Heather Lopez: Marking as high priority and routing to deal-desk now.
Karen Park: I'll draft the amendment for capped spend + auto-throttle and share a redline in the channel.
Tom Nguyen: I'll scope the infra playbook for burst pre-warm, how to honor cap, and failover region behavior.
Maria Chen: Great. I'll circle back to AcmeHealth to confirm A100-only and ask for traffic profile.
